title: Terminal Link persistence failure makes Node receive loop spin
description: LinkLayer.receive raises terminal persistence failure before its first await; Node._receive_loop catches generic Exception and immediately continues. After one fatal storage error the task becomes a no-await hot loop, starving the event loop and flooding logs. Expose/classify terminal Link failure and transition Node to failed/stopped or surface task failure instead of retrying. Add injected persistence-failure tests proving bounded receive calls, scheduler progress, observable lifecycle error, and no log storm.
